items.title: Milky Mist Q1 Results: Profit zooms nearly 9 times YoY to Rs 65 crore; revenue rises 44%
items.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food reported a nearly ninefold jump in Q1FY27 profit to Rs 65 crore, while revenue rose 43.6% year-on-year to Rs 973.45 crore. Strong demand for ice cream, curd and yogurt, higher volumes, improved product mix and operational efficiencies helped drive gross and EBITDA margin expansion.
